long_description: Contour is the enterprise voice AI platform for healthcare logistics. Provider networks, telemedicine companies, labs, and multi-site clinics use Contour to automate high volume, repetitive phone workflows that traditionally require dedicated back office staff. Built for regulated environments, Contour integrates directly with core clinical systems to handle every call with full auditability and HIPAA compliance.
name: Contour
one_liner: AI voice agents for healthcare operational calls
